name: Wave Assist
description: Learning bot: remembers your best run and clicks, and after each death tries a click one step earlier until it passes.

assist-enabled.name: Enable Assist
assist-enabled.description: Turn the learning bot on or off.

assist-replay.name: Replay best run
assist-replay.description: Repeat the clicks of the best run in the next attempts.

max-back-steps.name: Max steps back
max-back-steps.description: How many steps earlier the bot may try before it flips the click, then gives up on that spot.

show-hud.name: Show status
show-hud.description: Show the learning status in the top left corner.

practice-only.name: Only in practice mode
practice-only.description: Use the bot only in practice mode.
